title: Recipe packs
summary: Discover independent catalogs and share general or job-specific recipes, skills and character setups with reviewed installation.
author: Viral Hit contributors

inputs.label: What the user wants to make
inputs.description: The format, job or audience, such as vertical product ads, slide stories or any project.

inputs.label: Pack link
inputs.description: Optional HTTPS or GitHub file link to a pack someone shared.

stages.title: Find a pack
stages.description: List offered packs or fetch a shared link and match them to the request by scope and use cases.

stages.title: Review before installing
stages.description: Show recipes, setup needs, missing runtime steps and conflicts; install the reviewed manifest with its digest.

stages.title: Build and share
stages.description: Compose a pack from local recipes and hand the user a file or link-ready JSON.
